title: Serverware native retained-service principal preflight configuration v4
description: Closed service-only cold original, at most 16384 bytes. The standalone workload sidecar admits genuine fresh startup once and retains immutable leaf, CA, source and original certificate/PKI/service bounds. Every new outer TLS connection requires a fresh existing PrincipalSession proof and exact same initial identity. This does not renew startup, grant hot replacement, claim live revocation or authorize a provider request. Legacy NativeIngressAdmission v1-v3 rejects v4 and retains its original freshness semantics.

startupEvidence.description: Held nativeIngressPublicEvidence/v1 original, at most 65536 bytes. Genuine initial startup verification uses the unchanged 1..300 second freshness limit, before private-key use.

startupExpectations.description: Independent nativeIngressAttestationExpectations/v1 original, at most 16384 bytes, including complete startup scope and nonce.

sessionScope.description: Nonce-free nativeIngressSessionScope/v1 original, at most 16384 bytes; static scope matches startup. Each connection owns a new live challenge, not a reset or reused admission.

trustRoots.description: Independent native Nitro PKI trust-root original, at most 1048576 bytes. Native profile requires the existing no-CRL boundary; this service makes no live revocation or witness claim.

workloadIssuer.description: Canonical single-certificate PEM, at most 65536 bytes, DER at most 16384. Initial verification authenticates membership in native framed-DER trust inventory; every connection proves the same initial leaf/CA against the actual selected target chain. Installation diagnostics are not evidence.

expectedPrincipal.description: Independent expected policy principal, exact match to the retained sidecar principal. Runtime rejects surrounding whitespace and controls and enforces byte length; no caller identity headers substitute.

expectedIdentityPolicySha256.description: Independent exact current identity-policy commitment, not a route grant, bearer credential or inferred readiness result.
